item.subject: science
item.prompt: How long does it take for Earth to complete one full orbit around the Sun?
item.explanation: Earth orbits the Sun once every 365 days, which is one year. This journey creates our seasons and the passage of time through the calendar year.
item.factClaim: Earth takes one year (365 days) to complete one orbit around the Sun.
item.factCheckSource: NASA, Britannica - confirm Earth's orbital period is approximately 365.25 days
